note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every entry). Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; facts are drawn from the sources named beside each guide, never copied from them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough and no online trophies. Keep cheats off the whole run: PowerPyx and GTABase both report that cheats switch off trophies and saving.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks at the end of the mission. It is the first trophy most players will earn.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through Chapter 1 to its end; PowerPyx reports it pops once the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing this guide flags as missable: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; PowerPyx reports it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: both characters become switchable, which most of the free-roam trophies need.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx reports it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the jewelry robberies, the Key Cloner and Randy's car list unlock, so take the side content as it appears.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx reports it pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. The bank-vault robberies that Chapter 4 introduces feed straight into Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed, and one of only two golds in the list. Finish the final story mission and it pops at the end. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start of the final chapter — PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of every chapter, using the game's 15 manual save slots.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is a mission trophy, so just play the story — no extra objective is needed.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It pops at the end of the mission, like every other mission trophy.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. No side objective is required — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks when the mission ends, with nothing else to do.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The same airport, VCIA, is where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can is earned later — stealing a docked airliner there.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last mission trophy in the list, so once it pops the story trophies are done except the final mission itself.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. The 100% checklist appears only after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx stresses the thresholds are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion. You need any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+), 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Most of it falls out of the other trophies; the checklist itself tells you what is left.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the quickest: PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridges runs the fastest. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done. The story introduces most of them on its own, and the rest appear as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map, so this usually pops by itself while you chase the other trophies.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. PowerPyx reports the gold times are not too hard, and the ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. All 42 golds are also on the 100% checklist, so this is not optional for the platinum. Work through the ranges after the story when you can reach them all freely.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, so one win per location is enough. The drone races also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and all of them are required for the 100% checklist. Race locations are marked once the map is unfogged; take them in free-roam after the story.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so you only need to win half of them, and each location counts once. Races also feed Master of None. Pick the short, easy circuits first and repeat nothing — a second win at the same spot does not add to the count.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there — the challenge itself is the unlock, not just catching a fish. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — every level, at least once; you do not need to beat all of its challenges. There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. Pick whichever you like best; one finished game is enough.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-mission questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: 7 shipwrecks in total. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he calls, then appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so the line is not missable.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-mission questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands — but not every side questline counts. PowerPyx warns that the questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk's Skunk Ape line (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's line (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago's line (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete's line (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). All of them are still findable in free-roam after the story; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants. The line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list, and entering one pops a prompt to deliver it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Deliver in good condition for more money; cars show up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-part questline, which is Jason-only. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point at Synthetic Labs in Vice City, which you destroy in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2, and you cannot do the last one until both characters are playable together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, at Jason's house, Lucia will talk about meditating in the kitchen in the morning (PowerPyx reports this happens after the mission Down to Earth) and walk out to the balcony — follow her, accept, and she teaches you to meditate. That balcony meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, but its author had done it when the trophy popped — do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this does not threaten A Long Road either way.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 18 Meditation Spot Locations
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it — the line is Jason-only). After that quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest also gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are on the 100% checklist. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work through Bret's line and it will come.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card sets in total, so you only need 3 of them — pick the sets whose cards are closest together and finish those first. Cards are found across Leonida; the 100% checklist does not require card sets at all, so this is a standalone cleanup trophy best done in free-roam after the story.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up to open it, then hold R1 to scan what you are looking at. There are far more than 100 — PowerPyx breaks them down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and it builds up on its own; the same app is how you scan vehicles for Whip It Good.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there — leave it for late, when dozens will already be done without trying. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; scrolling over one shows a checkmark when it is done. With 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, you can skip the hardest ones entirely.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then break away on a fast sports bike and cut through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the bank vaults there always trigger 4 stars.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the red and blue flashing wanted state has to stay up the whole time, not the red heat zone. This needs both characters together, so it is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle. PowerPyx recommends an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs, and if the pop does not come after the third store, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the last shop.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. The fastest method is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops long before that target is done.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. Prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the window. Then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you have done the other trophies you will likely be at level 4 and this will come naturally.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. PowerPyx's easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so be ready to fight your way out.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map in unfogged areas. Enter through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door (kicking trips the alarm). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx's suggested spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vaults unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch the guard carry a briefcase of cash inside, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that mission, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (finish his Payday Loans quests first), which mark vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that opens the bank vaults — has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing the truck. Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, this pops on its own. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray).

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — in practice, fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it after the story, when the whole map is open and you can fly freely. Unfogging also reveals the activity, race and robbery icons that the other trophies need.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, bottom right. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way there.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy — a small, deliberate moment, and one of the easiest in the list. PowerPyx names the exact drink and spot, so do not substitute another bar.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it out through the window: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window — the pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are further down the street. It only works with this blue Banshee, not any other car; it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The bowling alley is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, take the luxury watch from the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left — the trophy is not missable.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon) and always bring your partner along (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. There are clubs all over Vice City, and a home gym becomes available after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do shifts your reputation. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive, so avoid farming your way into it. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this usually fills up passively while you work on the other trophies; if it is last, PowerPyx's fallback is running over civilians and cops with a car, carefully.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests failing something once and succeeding on the second try. Until a guide confirms it, do not chase it: play the Payday Loans content when it appears and check back — this guide will be updated as the community pins it down. No source has confirmed a method yet, and this entry will not invent one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On a motorcycle or a push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — and keep moving: each kick has to land, and the timer is tight, so line up a run through a busy stretch rather than circling one spot. Despite the bowling name, this has nothing to do with the bowling alley trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — PowerPyx notes Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist: bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, though those only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. It is cumulative and counts everything — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts the shop types as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Buy the gear you actually want for the other trophies and the total builds up on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, for $160,000 in total. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy through the app. Robberies are the quick way to fund them, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots to register vehicles in.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and it lets you summon registered vehicles to your location. You need enough garages first — each garage adds one or more parking spots (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
